ItemID: NA; Title: Joywayus Hex Nipple 1/4"NPT Male x 1/4"NPT Male Threaded Stainless Steel 304 Threaded Nipple Pipe Fittings for Brew Kit Home Piping (Pack of 5); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent work involves fastening and fabrication; I have no current pipe-fitting need.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could complement my UNC rivet nuts, and the broad heads look useful for securing panels after checking fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: VIGRUE 1/4 x 1" to 3" Hex Lag Bolts, 108PCS 1/4 Hex Lag Screws Wood Screws Washers Assortment kit 18-8(304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The range of lengths would expand my fastening supplies for heavier wood assemblies.
ItemID: NA; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use measuring tools, but I have no current pressure-system project requiring this range or fitting.
ItemID: NA; Title: 5/16"-18 Stainless Steel Lock Nut 30pcs ROARADE 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Hex Lock Nylon Insert Nut (30, 5/16"-18); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Lock nuts fit my hardware interests, but I would wait until I need this specific thread size.
ItemID: NA; Title: M3 x 25mm (100 pcs) Flanged Button Head Socket Cap Sheet Metal Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Allen Hex Drive 2mm, Wood Screws with Self Tapping Point; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These self-tapping screws would not serve the same purpose as the threaded metric bolts and inserts I have been collecting.
ItemID: NA; Title: AmazonCommercial 20 Gallon Heavy Duty Round Trash/Garbage Can, Grey, 2-pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for project tools and hardware right now, with no immediate need for two large trash cans.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1/4"-20 x 3" Stainless Steel Button Head Socket Cap Screws with Hex Nuts, Flat Washers and Lock Washers Hardware Assortment, 304 Stainless Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, 10 Sets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Complete matching sets would be convenient for fabrication, though I would check whether the three-inch length suits the assembly.
ItemID: NA; Title: M5-0.8 x 45mm (50 pcs) Hexagon Socket Head Cap Screws, Furniture Screws, Connecting Bolts, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Bright Finish, Metric Standard; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These match my interest in metric fastening, but fifty identical long bolts feel premature without a specific fit requirement.
ItemID: NA; Title: PIKA3D PLA 1.75mm Filament Refills, 20 Colors, 5 Meters Per Color, Works with SCRIB3D, MYNT3D and Most Other 3D Printing pens (Pika_PLA_100); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My craft purchases do not establish a need for printing-pen filament, and I have no indicated compatible pen.
